name: RMIT Accommodation Scholarship
summary: $6,000 for new RMIT students in financial hardship who have moved to Melbourne or Bendigo to study.
key: $6,000 for one year full-time, half for part-time. Up to 20 offered.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Commencing in Semester 1 2027 after moving to Melbourne, or to Bendigo from more than 90 minutes away.
Financial hardship, such as a low-income Centrelink payment or Health Care Card.
how: Apply direct to RMIT online (preferred) or through VTAC, with supporting documents.

evidence.quote: This scholarship provides $6,000 for one year for full-time enrolled students
